thread:
Ava: quick sync — following last week's paging storm i think we should update the incident command playbook and the on-call handoff checklist. noticed multiple pages were re-routed late and customer-impact classification was inconsistent. can we capture a small set of edits and owners?
IncidentBot: Incident 2026-03-02-672 closed (severity: sev2). 47 minutes active, 3 escalations, impacted hosted inference region us-west-2. Summary: autoscaler + model-variant fallback misconfiguration.
Samir: +1. saw the timeline — we had two handoffs where the incoming oncall didn't have the flipped routing state in their note. we should add an explicit "verify routing state" step.
Priya: agreed. i'm happy to own the runbook doc updates for the customer-impact decision tree. can we codify "noisy pages" thresholds (eg >3 pages in 30m => consider suppressing) and put an example matrix?
Luca: i'll take the handoff checklist and the canary/fallback section. also want to add a small automation that tags incidents that hit both latency and error SLOs so the postmortem route is clear.
Ava: thanks. thinking we also need an IC switchboard section: who takes IC when pager is in travel mode, how to escalate to product/contact apis team — current flow is fuzzy. propose: IC role -> Tech Lead -> Service Owner -> SRE oncall. put timeboxes too.
Samir: timeboxes are key. suggest: IC initial triage (15m), mitigation window (45m), exec sync if unresolved at 2h. that maps to our runbook doc headers.
Priya: also, customer impact taxonomy: customer-facing outage (affects >5% p95 requests for >10m), degraded (increased errors but fallback engaged), informational. we should add examples for hosted vs dedicated customers.
Luca: here's a draft checklist snippet i used in the last incident, please review and suggest edits:
```
- Handoff checklist (incoming)
  - Confirm oncall roster and escalation path
  - Confirm routing state: primary region, fallback enabled/disabled
  - Check model variant mappings and quantization flags
  - Confirm KV cache warm state for hot endpoints
  - Note any outstanding maintenance windows
```
Samir: love that. can we add a one-line play for "if pages keep coming after mitigation, escalate to capacity-owner and flip to smaller model variant"?
Ava: yes add that under mitigation plays. also add a standard message template for customer comms so we don't scramble on wording. ex: "We are investigating high latency in us-west-2 impacting X% of requests. Mitigation in progress; next update in 30m."
IncidentBot: New runbook PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pulls/1245 by Priya — title: "oncall: incident command update + customer-impact taxonomy"
Priya: PR has the taxonomy and initial examples. still need the routing verification step and the IC switchboard section from Luca/Ava.
Luca: i'll drop a commit later today for the automation tags (ops-automation ticket #298). planning to add an incident label when both error_rate and p95_latency exceed thresholds for two consecutive windows.
Ava: coordination plan: 1) Priya updates taxonomy + customer comm templates (owner: Priya, due: 2026-03-18) 2) Luca updates handoff checklist + automation tags (owner: Luca, due: 2026-03-20) 3) Samir adds explicit routing verification step + mitigation play for model fallback (owner: Samir, due: 2026-03-18) 4) Ava to run a 30-min review and signoff (owner: Ava, tentative: 2026-03-22). please add items to the PR and link commits.
Samir: calendared a 30m slot 2026-03-22 09:30 PT. added draft agenda: review checklist, taxonomy mapping, automation tags, one-button handoff script.
Priya: added examples for hosted/dedicated customers to the PR and included suggested customer message templates. left comments for the routing verification wording.
Luca: pushed initial automation rules branch, referencing ops-automation #298. note: needs test infra to simulate fallback flips. cc @OpsAutomations for test harness.
OpsAutomations: received. we'll add a synthetic test case and schedule a run in the canary namespace. ETA: 2026-03-19.
Ava: two follow-ups: (a) add a short section in the runbook about "what to log during a handoff" (minimal fields: active mitigations, last 3 alerts, who is IC) and (b) ensure the incident bot posts a short summary to #incidents channel when sev2+ closes. any objections?
Samir: no objections. the "last 3 alerts" bit will help on correlation.
Priya: +1 on incident bot summary. that would reduce manual writeups for initial postmortem drafts.
Luca: ok on both. also we should version the runbook (v1.1 -> v1.2) in the header and add a changelog section. small but helps triage history.
Ava: agreed. final ask: once PR is merged, let's run a tabletop (15m) during next oncall overlap to walk through a simulated handoff and one mitigation flip. owners commit to being present. sound good?
Samir: sounds good. i'll prep the flip script. :+1: :eyes:
Priya: i'll prepare two sample customer messages (severe vs degraded) and add them to the templates.
Luca: will be online for the tabletop. i'll also demo the automation tag.
IncidentBot: Reminder scheduled: tabletop exercise on 2026-03-23 17:00 UTC.
Ava: thank you team — i'll update the playbook section in the console and file the post-merge checklist. leaving this thread open for minor edits. :rocket:
